svg.title: Image-conditioned normalized KD-force directions
svg.desc: Three fixed-quantile CIFAR-100 examples. Per card, angular, scale/norm, and raw KD feature forces are normalized and drawn in a pair-local plane.
svg.text: Fixed input, three normalized KD forces
Each card uses one real CIFAR-100 image; arrow length is fixed so only the force direction remains.
Selection: nearest q25/q50/q75 of raw-versus-angular force deviation among the fixed 128-image probe; not selected by accuracy or visual effect.
